items.a: This depends on the type of service. With SMM, the first results — follower growth, engagement and inquiries — begin to appear within 4–6 weeks. With SEO, the first ranking improvements are seen within 2–3 months, while significant results are achieved in 4–6 months. We provide detailed monthly reports so you can track progress together with us.

SEO (Search Engine Optimisation) ensures your website appears at the top of search engines like Google. The vast majority of people only look at the first page of search results. Without SEO, potential customers simply cannot find you. With the right SEO strategy, you can attract free, targeted traffic to your site, increase brand credibility and gain a long-term competitive advantage.

items.q: Why is social media marketing (SMM) important?
items.a: Millions of people in Azerbaijan spend time on Instagram, Facebook and TikTok every day. Through SMM, you can introduce your brand to this audience, build direct relationships with customers and increase your sales. Professional SMM management — with the right content strategy, timely posts, targeted ads and active communication — strengthens your brand's online reputation.

items.q: What is the minimum budget for your services?
items.a: The budget varies depending on the type, scope and duration of the service. Every business has different needs — which is why we apply an individual approach. You can estimate the price using our calculator or contact us to learn about the package that suits you best.

items.q: Do you provide support after the project is completed?
items.a: Yes, we are here for you even after the project is completed. We offer various support packages for technical assistance, content updates and website management. Long-term partnership is our priority.

items.q: What payment terms do you apply?
items.a: Typically, 50% advance at the start of the project and the remaining 50% upon completion. An instalment payment plan can also be applied for larger projects. Bank transfer, cash and online payment systems are accepted.

digitalAds.faqQ1: How many days does the ad campaign start?
digitalAds.faqA1: Ad campaigns start within 24-48 hours. Additional payment is required for urgent campaigns.
digitalAds.faqQ2: How much should the advertising budget be?
digitalAds.faqA2: Minimum advertising budget is 10 AZN per day. We recommend 30-50 AZN per day for optimal results.
digitalAds.faqQ3: How can I track the results?
digitalAds.faqA3: We provide monthly reports and real-time statistics. We also send daily updates via WhatsApp.
